text:
maria: Quick sync — we need a short protocol for signer key handoff during the upcoming base-image rebuild. Goals: least-priv RBAC, short-lived signer tokens, auditable KMS usage, and an emergency revoke checklist.
kevin: +1. Proposed: new key in KMS, asymmetricSign bound only to signing-runner-sa, token TTL 15m minted via STS. I'll map image owners.
jen: pipeline change: require cosign attest predicate and fail the build if missing. Also add LABEL org.build.id baked at build time.
sam: monitoring: alert if AsymmetricSign called by non-allowlisted principal or if image push lacks attestation. Triage rota: sam primary for kernel/host issues, jen for container deps.
ops-bot: creating sinks: kms usage -> gs://kms-audit-13mo, image events -> gs://images-audit-24mo; pubsub alerts to #incidents for anomalies.
kms-bot: new key ready: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rebuildKR/cryptoKeys/signer-2026. Binding will be restricted.
maria: emergency revoke short commands to include in runbook: remove IAM binding, disable key version, disable signer SA. Keep that snippet handy in incident playbook.
kevin: i'll run a staging dry-run (cosign sign/verify + fake principal alert) this week and share results.
jen: will prepare RBAC YAML and pipeline PR; making attestation a hard gate for prod.
maria: action items: kevin owner map + dry-run (due 4/10), jen RBAC + pipeline (due 4/12), ops-bot sinks & alerts (done 4/13). Schedule maintenance window for IAM updates after dry-run.
ops-bot: maintenance window requested: 2026-04-15T02:00:00Z -> 2026-04-15T04:00:00Z. Infra-oncall notified.
maria: great — i'll update the runbook with the revoke snippet and attestation schema, then ping before rollout. :thumbsup:
